collection.title: Ford Fusion 2002 to 2012 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Ford Fusion 2002 - 2012 model requires a 22" wiper blade for both the drivers and a 16" passengers side with a Standard Hook arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle, with the option of upgrading to the Retrofit Flat type of windscreen wiper. The choice of rear screen wipers for this Fusion which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
